name: audio-description
useCase: Indicate an audio-described track or an audio description setting.
misuse: Do not use this mark for ordinary audio playback or subtitles.

16.reason: The sloped A, upright D and three parallel sound waves retain their familiar proportions without a frame crowding the small letters.

24.reason: The letters and three equal sound waves share their cap height, baseline and weight, with open counters and a centered overall shape.
